csv_scope_of_work: The services include preparation of construction contract plans to mill and fill 3.8 miles of the pavement, repair approximately 600 feet of stream bank on four (4) slips and replace 5 culverts on the Paint Creek Recreational Trail in Ross County. Pavement rehabilitation begins at Westfall Road and ends an estimated 3/10ths of a mile east of Musselman Station Road cul-de-sac. Two locations within this segment of the Paint Creek Recreational Trail require erosion repair of streambank. The first location consists of two slips and is located half a mile east of Westfall Road. The second location consists of two slips, and the replacement of one (1) culvert located 3/10ths of a mile east of the intersection of Overlake Road and Musselman Station Road. 39 22'46"N 83 09'08"W.
